status: Prior specification and coverage-ledger asset; not independently accepted or publication ready

recipient.name: Glide Foundation
recipient.boundary: Ordinary unrestricted Foundation gift. Consolidated financial context includes Church/property affiliates; no separate Church gift or presumed clinical effect.

finance.basis: Final audit, not impact report's pending-audit numbers. Cash is historical, not current spare funding.

shared_basis.funding_additionality: Prior 0.4 [0,0.8]: current public grants, other donors and fixed capacity remain in no-gift world. Not estimated from contributions ratio.
shared_basis.capacity_gift: 100k scenario scale and assumed maximum absorbable tranche, NOT observed room; unknown room must be visible. Gift above cap still fully costed with capped output.
shared_basis.common_external_fraction: 0.2 [0,0.8] gross associated volunteer/common partner resources beyond branch-specific costs, not causal net cost or waived charges. Excludes clinical resources separately specified.
shared_basis.geography: Bay0.99/SF0.95 priors, nested. No additional indirect Bay/SF benefit assigned; policy spillovers unresolved.

allocation_basis: Retains v1 top-level allocation priors; subdivides 7% other HEAT and 10% family. Entire gift costed; allocation does not cancel out of benefits. Not observed budget fractions. Service counts constrain plausibility, not QALYs.

survival_basis.costs: Rescue nominal annual unique-person safer-use/rescue-support package, not price per dose. MOUD Foundation cost is annualized access/support cost prior, minimum one annual budget unit for setup; active durations above one year scale Foundation/external costs linearly. External cost includes medication, prescribing, labs and public clinical delivery. 3%*30.77m/56 enrollees≈16.5k is only a plausibility check, not audited program cost or evidence of additional patients.
survival_basis.counts: Impact report says 56 people enrolled in MAT, not verified deduplicated longitudinal treatment records. No 56*survival multiplier. Per-gift capacity10 is a prior and must stress to zero.
survival_basis.baseline: Both rescue and medication compare with same current-care hazard. Medication effect shrunk halfway from observed HR0.63 toward1; no-gift treatment share handles replacement of existing accessible medication, retention handles effective funded-course completion, funding additionality handles donor displacement. None is a second multiplication by trial ITT adherence.
survival_basis.survival: Three exclusive cohorts rescue-only/MOUD-only/both. While active h=(base-rescueReduction)*(1-(1-HR)*transfer) for both; remove each factor when its active period ends. Equal baseline hazard after funded care preserves but does not create a survival gap, capped at15years. No separate opioid deaths added to all-cause.

housing_basis: 10k complete access/stabilization episode is a new prior, not v1 transfer-oriented3077. Current965254/317≈3045 is transfer per reported person, not full cost. 10% consolidated scale/317≈9706 contextual only. Stability difference0.112*0.5 transfer from prior VA evidence, capped by current80% no-gift stability. Unique-health exclusion prevents housing mood/safety stacking.

groups.basis: Thirty-day 90-meal course at12/meal; meal supply consumed and replaces inadequate intake in selected20%, with50% symptom-response/local transfer. 0.015 utility for physical/mental symptoms only, not hunger preference or tailored-diet disease effect. Distinct symptom-time65%. No future mortality. Cost plausibility22%*30.77m/620513≈10.9/meal, not observed marginal price.
groups.sensitivity: 0.015 utility [-0.01,0.05]; selected share [0,0.5]; course30days [7,90] with proportional meal costs.

groups.basis: One caregiver per meaningful class/support course; distressed share30%, trial-to-GLIDE delivery35%, unique mood/safety70%. Utility.03 and half-year window are weak priors; not trial-derived QALYs; catchup2/year. No child benefit in this row.

One child with selected emotional/behavioral symptoms in meaningful socioemotional activity; not childcare economic value. Selected20%, effective-fidelity20% sharply below targeted12-week IY. Clinical utility and benefit probability weak priors; no parent spillover or lifetime conduct/crime/earnings.

One selected crisis/safety-support course;35% relevant trauma/abuse symptoms,30% effective clinical gain probability,60% distinct mood/safety outside housing/CBT. Weak positive central despite null advocacy counterweight, acknowledging intensive successful cases; no homicide survival or outreach multiplier.

One course rather than attendee visit;40% persistent depression,30% meaningful CBT-response/local delivery,60% distinct symptom-time. Mixed outpatient groups not BRIGHT's32hour residential protocol. Utility.08 separate judgment, no substance-use mortality added.

One unique testing/linkage episode;6% actionable RNA-positive untreated HCV,5% earlier effective cure difference vs existing public referral,60% distinct morbidity. No 44.2point colocated RCT transplant and no paused peer program. Three-year symptom benefit only with later-care catchup; no liver deaths or transmission added. Treatment resource charged separately per selected patient, not per all test.
groups.sensitivity: Actionable[0,.2], earlier cure difference[-.05,.2], utility[-.01,.08], H[0,5].

groups.basis: One acute wound-care course with partner medical resources;40% clinically symptomatic wounds,50% earlier meaningful healing relative to accessible public care,70% distinct physical symptom-time. Utility.06 and14day window clinical judgment, not measured GLIDE trial; no unobserved admissions or sepsis mortality.
groups.sensitivity: Utility[-.03,.15], target[0,.8], response[0,.9], days[0,60] with duration-sensitive resources.

unresolved.reason: No causally attributable policy probability, displaced public spending or recipient map; cannot claim coalition budget as QALYs.
unresolved.required_stress: Signed independently elicited total policy Q with geography; no generic residual expected mean.

unresolved.reason: Safer-use prevention, HIV/STI treatment and secondary transmission plausibly material but no case/diagnosis mix. HCV subgroup alone is not complete infection effect.
unresolved.required_stress: Separate selected incidence/diagnosis/care-acceleration parameters and finite competing-risk benefit; do not duplicate HCV or MOUD people-years.

unresolved.reason: Wound care is named selected branch; vaccination counts/disease risks and other completed care unavailable.
unresolved.required_stress: Disease-specific vaccine or acute-care priors after cost/coverage allocation; no automatic course Q.

unresolved.reason: Exact Foundation-to-affiliate marginal flow not identified. Church activities not automatically Foundation donation effects.

expectation.reason: Do not use central scenario price as whole-organization expected-value headline. Explicit correlated scenario weights and unresolved material branches need review.

hcv_external_treatment_cost_basis: Gross course drug/lab/prescribing resource prior per nominal actionable HCV patient, before donor additionality or health-success discount; separate from testing cost. This over-associates some unchanged baseline care and is not net induced cost. No charge only for successful cures.
